newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland plans cargo airport near Lodz.
newsitem.headline: Poland plans cargo airport near Lodz.

text.p: Poland plans to convert and expand a military airfield near the central city of Lodz into a cargo airport which could start operating late next year, an official at Lodz's governor office said on Thursday.
"After choosing (investors), who could in 1998 carry out necessary investments, the airport could start operating by the end of next year at the earliest," Andrzej Cymerman said.

He said the state treasury would donate land for the airport in the town of Lask, near Lodz, while investors who will build necessary facilities would later be entitled to use the field and exploit it.
He said tenders for investors would be announced next year.
Cymerman said the Lask airport was likely to succeed as the cargo capacity of Warsaw's Okecie airport was fully used and there was still demand for further cargo services in Poland.
